Elon explains why rockets are the wrong tool for the Moon
caption:
A mass driver is basically a magnetic catapult built on the Moon's surface. No rocket fuel. Just a long electromagnetic track that accelerates cargo until it's moving fast enough to escape the Moon entirely.

The Moon's gravity is about one sixth of Earth's, so you only need to reach roughly 2.4 km per second to break free. That's still blindingly fast, but far more achievable with electricity than with burning propellant. One solar-powered track could make thousands of launches for the cost of a handful of rocket trips.

The concept has been studied since the 1970s. What's changed is that the push to mine materials on the Moon and ship them to Mars or deep space is finally serious, and rockets simply don't make economic sense at that scale. This is the alternative.
